asr_text: And so, my fellow Americans, ask not what your country can do for you, ask what you can do for your country.

asr_text: This has indeed been a harassing day, continued the young man, his eyes fixed upon his friend

asr_text: There was something in his air and manner that betrayed to the scout the utter confusion of the state of his mind. For God's sake, my lady mother, give me a wife who would be an agreeable companion not one who will disgust me so that we may both bear evenly and with mutual good will the yoke imposed on us by heaven, instead of pulling this way and that way and fretting each other to death
